title: 第3章 恳请神明救天下百姓第4章 以他生命为代价
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 战承胤把餐盒塞进他们怀里，“神仙会再给本将军食物，你们收下。”
十位将领面面相觑，想推脱，可又想到饿得奄奄一息的家人。
只觉得怀里千斤般重！
家有小儿即将饿死的吴三郎，他率先收下。
他单膝下跪，含泪道：“多谢将军，我能不能先送回家中，妻子和孩子饿得快不行了。”
战承胤点头。“快送回去吧！”
吴三郎抱起餐盒，率先跑回家中。
剩下九位将士，把饭盒藏在怀里，把食物送回家里。
战承胤嘱咐他们早些回来，一起喝粥。
别看小小的一盒米饭菜肴，若是熬成粥，一家人省点能吃两天，顶上几日不被饿死。
若加上树叶草皮，能挨更长时间。
半炷香后，十位将士回来了，一个个脸色紧绷着，眼眶通红。
坐下后，李叔端了一锅粥进来。
半盒米饭熬成粥，再加半盒菜肴。
粥熬得不稠也不稀，刚好。
伴有菜色，香味瞬间飘出来。
李叔拿出十一个小碗，每人舀了一碗，放在将士面前。
战承胤瞧见，对他说：“李叔，一起吃吧！你好几天没吃东西了。”
李叔吃了观音土，已经出现腹胀。
他垂泪，用衣袖擦拭眼角。
“将军，不用了，您和诸位是将领，还要靠你们退敌，应当多吃点。”
战承胤锅底舀了最后一小碗粥，放到他面前。
他捧着热乎乎的粥，喜极而泣，红着眼眶退下了。
每人分到一小碗。
虽然吃不饱，但是足够美味，白米饭熬的粥还是香啊。
吃完舔碗，唇齿间依旧留香。
大家依依不舍把碗放下。
想着神仙既知道他们缺水缺粮，能否向她乞求祷告，赐下多些水和粮食。
八盒饭，实在不够分！
还有两万官兵，八万百姓，处在缺水缺粮的水深火热中。
人被逼急了，什么都敢做。
来时路上，陈魁将军就看见两家妇人，哭着交换死去孩子，易子而食。
还有家中老人自杀，叫子孙吃掉自己，只为家人能活下去。
这一桩桩，一件件的人间惨剧……
他们不怕战场上战死，却怕看百姓挨饿，叫亲人食其骨肉。
都心如刀割般难受。
如果能向神明乞求赐下更多的水和食物，便不会有这么多人间惨剧发生！
战承胤双手握拳！
他不知道食物和水哪来的。
亦不敢信世上真的有神明。
倘若有，他为国鞠躬尽瘁的家人，不会被皇帝赐死。
content_en:
Zhan Chengyin stuffed the lunch box into their arms, "The gods will give me more food, please accept it."
The ten generals looked at each other in confusion, wanting to shirk the situation, but they also thought of their families who were dying of hunger.
I just feel as heavy as a thousand pounds in my arms!
Wu Sanlang, who had a child who was about to starve to death, took the lead in accepting it.
He knelt down on one knee and said with tears in his eyes: "Thank you, general. Can I send you home first? My wife and children are very hungry."
Zhan Chengyin nodded. "Send it back quickly!"
Wu Sanlang picked up the lunch box and ran home first.
The remaining nine soldiers hid their lunch boxes in their arms and sent the food home.
Zhan Chengyin asked them to come back early and have porridge together.
Regardless of the small box of rice dishes, if it is cooked into porridge, the family can eat it for two days and not starve to death for a few days.
If you add leaves and turf, it can last longer.
After half a stick of incense, the ten soldiers came back, all with tense faces and red eyes.
After sitting down, Uncle Li came in with a pot of porridge.
Make half a box of rice into porridge, and add half a box of vegetables.
The porridge is neither thick nor thin, just right.
Along with the dishes, the aroma wafts out instantly.
Uncle Li took out eleven small bowls, each scooped out a bowl, and placed them in front of the soldiers.
Zhan Chengyin saw it and said to him, "Uncle Li, let's eat together! You haven't eaten for several days."
Uncle Li had abdominal distension after eating Guanyin soil.
He wept and wiped his eyes with his sleeve.
"General, no need. You and all of you are generals, and we have to rely on you to defeat the enemy. You should eat more."
Zhan Chengyin scooped out the last small bowl of porridge from the bottom of the pot and placed it in front of him.
Holding the hot porridge, he cried with joy and withdrew with red eyes.
Each person gets a small bowl.
Although it is not full, it is delicious enough, and the porridge cooked with white rice is still delicious.
After eating, licking the bowl, the fragrance is still lingering on your lips and teeth.
Everyone reluctantly put down their bowls.
I wonder if the gods can pray to her to give them more water and food since they know they are short of water and food.
Eight boxes of lunch are really not enough!
There are still 20,000 officers and soldiers and 80,000 civilians who are in dire straits due to lack of water and food.
When people are driven into a hurry, they dare to do anything.
On the way here, General Chen Kui saw two women crying and exchanging their dead children.
There are also elderly people who commit suicide and ask their children and grandchildren to eat them, just so that their families can survive.
These human tragedies, one after another...
They are not afraid of dying on the battlefield, but they are afraid of seeing the people starving and having their relatives eat their flesh and blood.
Everyone's heart felt as painful as a knife.
If we could pray to the gods for more water and food, so many human tragedies would not happen!
Zhan Chengyin clenched his hands into fists!
He didn't know where the food and water came from.
I also can’t believe that there are really gods in the world.
If so, his family members who have dedicated their lives to the country will not be killed by the emperor.
title_en: Chapter 3: Asking the gods to save the people of the world Chapter 4: At the cost of his life
